title: Inventory and Undertow
author: Bram Brightwater
blurb: Casper Reyes, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
